    <h1 class="devsite-page-title" tabindex="-1">
      Gemini Interactions API<devsite-actions hidden data-nosnippet>
    <devsite-llm-tools></devsite-llm-tools></devsite-actions>
  
      
    </h1>
  <div class="devsite-page-title-meta"><devsite-view-release-notes></devsite-view-release-notes></div>
  

  <devsite-toc class="devsite-nav"
    depth="2"
    devsite-toc-embedded
    >
  </devsite-toc>
  
    
  <div class="devsite-article-body clearfix
  ">

  
    
    
<p>The Gemini Interactions API allows developers to build generative AI applications using Gemini models. Gemini is our most capable model, built from the ground up to be multimodal. It can generalize and seamlessly understand, operate across, and combine different types of information including language, images, audio, video, and code. You can use the Gemini API for use cases like reasoning across text and images, content generation, dialogue agents, summarization and classification systems, and more.</p>
<div class="markdown-actions" style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 24px;">
<a class="md-button" href="/static/api/interactions.md.txt" target="_blank">View as markdown</a>
<a class="md-button" href="/static/api/interactions.openapi.json" target="_blank">View the OpenAPI Spec</a>
</div>
<aside class="note">
<p><strong>Beta</strong>: You are viewing the beta version of the Interactions API. Endpoints are under <code translate="no" dir="ltr">/v1beta/</code>. The stable <a href="/api/interactions-api-v1">v1 version</a> is also available.</p>
</aside>
<div class="api-version-toggle">
<span class="toggle-label">API version:</span>
<span class="version-btn active">v1beta</span>
<a class="version-btn" href="/api/interactions-api-v1">v1</a>
</div>

<div class="prototype" itemscope="" itemtype="http://developers.google.com/ReferenceObject">
<h2 id="CreateInteraction" data-text="Creating an interaction" tabindex="-1">Creating an interaction</h2>
<div>
<span class="endpoint">
<span class="http-method post">
                post
            </span>
</span>
<span class="endpoint-url" style="font-size: 16px; color: var(--devsite-code-color);">
            https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions
        </span>
</div>
<section id="description">
<p>Creates a new interaction.</p>
</section>
<section class="prototype">
<ul class="toc">
<li><a href="#CreateInteraction.PATH_PARAMETERS">Path / Query parameters</a></li><li><a href="#CreateInteraction.request_body">Request body</a></li> <li><a href="#CreateInteraction.response">Response</a></li>
</ul>
<div class="column-container request-section" style="margin-top: 48px;">
<div class="reference">
<section id="CreateInteraction.PATH_PARAMETERS">
<h3 id="path-query-parameters" data-text="Path / Query Parameters" tabindex="-1">Path / Query Parameters</h3>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">api_version</span>
<span class="field-type">string</span>
<span class="field-nessesity required"> (required)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Which version of the API to use.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="CreateInteraction.request_body">
<h3 id="request-body" data-text="Request body" tabindex="-1">Request body</h3>
<p>The request body contains data with the following structure:</p>
<details class="field-entry inline-details">
<summary class="signature">
<span class="expander-icon"></span>
<span class="field-name">model</span>
<span class="field-type">ModelOption</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </summary>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The name of the `Model` used for generating the interaction. <br/><strong>Required if `agent` is not provided.</strong></p>
<section class="prototype" style="padding-left: 16px;">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<p style="display: none;">The model that will complete your prompt.\n\nSee [models](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models) for additional details.</p>
<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="possible-values" data-text="Possible values" tabindex="-1">Possible values</h4>

<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">gemini-2.5-pro</code>

<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Gemini 3.1 Flash Image.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">gemini-3.5-flash</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Our most intelligent model for sustained frontier performance in agentic and coding tasks.</p> </li>

</section>
</div>
</details>
<details class="field-entry inline-details">
<summary class="signature">

<section class="prototype" style="padding-left: 16px;">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">

<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="possible-values_1" data-text="Possible values" tabindex="-1">Possible values</h4>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">

<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">low</code>

<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">medium</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Medium thinking level.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">high</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">High thinking level.</p> </li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<div class="field-description">
<p>Configuration for video generation.</p>
<section class="prototype" style="padding-left: 16px;">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<p style="display: none;">Configuration options for video generation.</p>
<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="fields_4" data-text="Fields" tabindex="-1">Fields</h4>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">task</span>
<span class="field-type">enum (string)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional task mode for video generation. If not specified, the model
automatically determines the appropriate mode based on the provided text
prompt and input media.</p>
<p style="margin-top: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Possible
            values:</p>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">text_to_video</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Generates video solely from a text prompt.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">image_to_video</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Generates video from one or two source images. The first image defines
the starting frame, and the optional second image defines the ending
frame.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">reference_to_video</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Generates video using reference media (such as images, audio, or video).</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">edit</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Modifies an existing input video.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">extend</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Extends an existing input video.</p> </li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</details>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>

<details class="field-entry inline-details">

<span class="field-type">FindRequest</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </summary>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Parameters for finding vulnerabilities.</p>
<section class="prototype" style="padding-left: 16px;">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<p style="display: none;">Request parameters specific to FIND sessions, used for discovering
vulnerabilities in a codebase.</p>
<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="fields_5" data-text="Fields" tabindex="-1">Fields</h4>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">description</span>
<span class="field-type">string</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Additional context or custom instructions provided by the user to guide
the vulnerability analysis.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">finding_id</span>
<span class="field-type">string</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The identifier of a specific finding to verify. This is primarily used in
VERIFY mode to focus the agent's execution-based validation on a single
vulnerability.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">mode</span>
<span class="field-type">enum (string)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The mode of the find session.</p>
<p style="margin-top: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Possible
            values:</p>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">scan</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Fast scan using only the initial classifier.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">verify</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Performs classification followed by detailed investigation.</p> </li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<details class="field-entry inline-details">
<summary class="signature">
<span class="expander-icon"></span>

<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </summary>
<div class="field-description">
<p>A list of source files to provide as context for the scan.</p>

<span class="field-name">content</span>

</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">path</span>
<span class="field-type">string</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The relative path of the file from the project root.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</details>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</details>
<details class="field-entry inline-details">
<summary class="signature">
<span class="expander-icon"></span>
<span class="field-name">fix_request</span>
<span class="field-type">FixRequest</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </summary>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Parameters for fixing vulnerabilities.</p>
<section class="prototype" style="padding-left: 16px;">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<p style="display: none;">Request parameters specific to FIX sessions, used for generating and
validating security patches.</p>
<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="fields_7" data-text="Fields" tabindex="-1">Fields</h4>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">description</span>
<span class="field-type">string</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Additional context or custom instructions provided by the user to guide
the patch generation process.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">finding_id</span>
<span class="field-type">string</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The identifier of the specific security finding to be remediated. This ID
maps to a previously discovered vulnerability.</p>
</div>
</div>
<details class="field-entry inline-details">
<summary class="signature">
<span class="expander-icon"></span>
<span class="field-name">source_files</span>
<span class="field-type">array (FileContent)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </summary>
<div class="field-description">
<p>A list of source files providing context for the remediation. These files
are typically the ones containing the identified vulnerability.</p>
<section class="prototype" style="padding-left: 16px;">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<p style="display: none;">Content of a single file in the codebase.</p>
<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="fields_8" data-text="Fields" tabindex="-1">Fields</h4>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">content</span>
<span class="field-type">string</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The UTF-8 encoded text content of the file.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">path</span>
<span class="field-type">string</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The relative path of the file from the project root.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</details>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</details>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">model</span>
<span class="field-type">string</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The name of the model to use for the CodeMender agent. One
CodeMender session will only use one model.</p>
</div>
</div>
<details class="field-entry inline-details">
<summary class="signature">
<span class="expander-icon"></span>

<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </summary>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional session-specific configurations to override default agent
behavior.</p>
<section class="prototype" style="padding-left: 16px;">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<p style="display: none;">The configuration of CodeMender sessions.</p>
<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="fields_9" data-text="Fields" tabindex="-1">Fields</h4>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">max_rounds</span>
<span class="field-type">integer</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The maximum number of interaction rounds the agent is allowed to perform
before reaching a timeout.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</details>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">session_id</span>

<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">

the same CodeMender session.</p>
</div>

<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">type</span>
<span class="field-type">object</span>
<span class="field-nessesity required"> (required)</span> </div>

</div>
</div>
</div>
</details>
<details class="subtype-details">
<summary class="subtype-summary">
<span style="font-weight: 500;">DeepResearchAgentConfig</span>
</summary>
<div class="subtype-content">
<p>Configuration for the Deep Research agent.</p>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">collaborative_planning</span>
<span class="field-type">boolean</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Enables human-in-the-loop planning for the Deep Research agent. If set to
true, the Deep Research agent will provide a research plan in its response.
The agent will then proceed only if the user confirms the plan in the next
turn.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">enable_bigquery_tool</span>
<span class="field-type">boolean</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Enables bigquery tool for the Deep Research agent.</p>
</div>
</div>
<details class="field-entry inline-details">
<summary class="signature">
<span class="expander-icon"></span>
<span class="field-name">thinking_summaries</span>
<span class="field-type">ThinkingSummaries</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </summary>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Whether to include thought summaries in the response.</p>
<section class="prototype" style="padding-left: 16px;">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<p style="display: none;"></p>
<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="possible-values_4" data-text="Possible values" tabindex="-1">Possible values</h4>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">auto</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Auto thinking summaries.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">none</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">No thinking summaries.</p> </li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</details>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">type</span>
<span class="field-type">object</span>
<span class="field-nessesity required"> (required)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>No description provided.</p>
<p>Always set to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"deep-research"</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">visualization</span>
<span class="field-type">enum (string)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Whether to include visualizations in the response.</p>
<p style="margin-top: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Possible
            values:</p>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">off</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Do not include visualizations.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">auto</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Automatically include visualizations.</p> </li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</details>
<details class="subtype-details">
<summary class="subtype-summary">
<span style="font-weight: 500;">DynamicAgentConfig</span>
</summary>
<div class="subtype-content">
<p>Configuration for dynamic agents.</p>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">type</span>
<span class="field-type">object</span>
<span class="field-nessesity required"> (required)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>No description provided.</p>
<p>Always set to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"dynamic"</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</details>
</div>
</details>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">environment</span>
<span class="field-type"><a href="#Resource:EnvironmentConfig">EnvironmentConfig</a> or string</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">

</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">

<span class="field-name">labels</span>
<span class="field-type">object</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>

<span class="field-type">string</span>

</div>
</div>
<details class="field-entry inline-details">
<summary class="signature">
<span class="expander-icon"></span>
<span class="field-name">safety_settings</span>
<span class="field-type">array (SafetySetting)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </summary>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Safety settings for the interaction.</p>
<section class="prototype" style="padding-left: 16px;">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<p style="display: none;">A safety setting that affects the safety-blocking behavior.

A SafetySetting consists of a
harm category and a
threshold for that
category.</p>
<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="fields_10" data-text="Fields" tabindex="-1">Fields</h4>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">method</span>
<span class="field-type">enum (string)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. The method for blocking content. If not specified, the default
behavior is to use the probability score.</p>
<p style="margin-top: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Possible
            values:</p>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">severity</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">The harm block method uses both probability and severity scores.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">probability</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">The harm block method uses the probability score.</p> </li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">threshold</span>
<span class="field-type">enum (string)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Required. The threshold for blocking content. If the harm probability
exceeds this threshold, the content will be blocked.</p>
<p style="margin-top: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Possible
            values:</p>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">block_low_and_above</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Block content with a low harm probability or higher.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">block_medium_and_above</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Block content with a medium harm probability or higher.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">block_only_high</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Block content with a high harm probability.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">block_none</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Do not block any content, regardless of its harm probability.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">off</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Turn off the safety filter entirely.</p> </li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<details class="field-entry inline-details">
<summary class="signature">
<span class="expander-icon"></span>
<span class="field-name">type</span>
<span class="field-type">HarmCategory</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </summary>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Required. The type of harm category to be blocked.</p>
<section class="prototype" style="padding-left: 16px;">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<p style="display: none;"></p>
<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="possible-values_5" data-text="Possible values" tabindex="-1">Possible values</h4>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">hate_speech</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Content that promotes violence or incites hatred against individuals or
groups based on certain attributes.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">dangerous_content</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Content that promotes, facilitates, or enables dangerous activities.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">harassment</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Abusive, threatening, or content intended to bully, torment, or ridicule.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">sexually_explicit</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Content that contains sexually explicit material.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">civic_integrity</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Deprecated: Election filter is not longer supported.
The harm category is civic integrity.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">image_hate</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Images that contain hate speech.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">image_dangerous_content</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Images that contain dangerous content.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">image_harassment</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Images that contain harassment.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">image_sexually_explicit</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Images that contain sexually explicit content.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">jailbreak</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Prompts designed to bypass safety filters.</p> </li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</details>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</details>
<details class="field-entry inline-details">
<summary class="signature">
<span class="expander-icon"></span>
<span class="field-name">service_tier</span>
<span class="field-type">ServiceTier</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </summary>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The service tier for the interaction.</p>
<section class="prototype" style="padding-left: 16px;">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<p style="display: none;"></p>
<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="possible-values_6" data-text="Possible values" tabindex="-1">Possible values</h4>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">flex</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Flex service tier.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">standard</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Standard service tier.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">priority</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Priority service tier.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">deferred</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Deferred service tier.</p> </li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</details>
<details class="field-entry inline-details">
<summary class="signature">
<span class="expander-icon"></span>
<span class="field-name">webhook_config</span>
<span class="field-type">WebhookConfig</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </summary>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. Webhook configuration for receiving notifications when the
interaction completes.</p>
<section class="prototype" style="padding-left: 16px;">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<p style="display: none;">Message for configuring webhook events for a request.</p>
<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="fields_11" data-text="Fields" tabindex="-1">Fields</h4>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">uris</span>
<span class="field-type">array (string)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. If set, these webhook URIs will be used for webhook events instead of the
registered webhooks.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">user_metadata</span>
<span class="field-type">object</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. The user metadata that will be returned on each event emission to the
webhooks.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>

                                    Example Response</h4>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" dir="ltr" translate="no" is-upgraded syntax="JSON"><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>

<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"id"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"v1_ChdPU0F4YWFtNkFwS2kxZThQZ05lbXdROBIXT1NBeGFhbTZBcEtpMWU4UGdOZW13UTg"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"model"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"gemini-3.6-flash"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"object"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"interaction"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>

<span class="field-name">stream</span>
<span class="field-type">boolean</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">

<h2 id="resources" style="margin-top: 64px;" data-text="Resources" tabindex="-1">Resources</h2>
<div itemscope="" itemtype="http://developers.google.com/ReferenceObject">
<h3 id="Resource:Interaction" data-text="Interaction" tabindex="-1">Interaction</h3>
<section class="prototype">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<p>The Interaction resource.</p>
<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="fields_12" data-text="Fields" tabindex="-1">Fields</h4>
<details class="field-entry inline-details">
<summary class="signature">
<span class="expander-icon"></span>
<span class="field-name">agent</span>
<span class="field-type">AgentOption</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </summary>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The name of the `Agent` used for generating the interaction.</p>
<section class="prototype" style="padding-left: 16px;">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<p style="display: none;">The agent to interact with.</p>
<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="possible-values_7" data-text="Possible values" tabindex="-1">Possible values</h4>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">deep-research-pro-preview-12-2025</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Gemini Deep Research Agent</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">deep-research-preview-04-2026</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Gemini Deep Research Agent</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">deep-research-max-preview-04-2026</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Gemini Deep Research Max Agent</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">antigravity-preview-05-2026</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Use the Antigravity managed agent to perform multi-step tasks that require reasoning, file operations, and tool use.</p> </li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</details>
<details class="field-entry inline-details">
<summary class="signature">
<span class="expander-icon"></span>
<span class="field-name">agent_config</span>
<span class="field-type">object</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </summary>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Configuration parameters for the agent interaction.</p>
<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="possible-types_2" data-text="Possible Types" tabindex="-1">Possible Types</h4>
<p>Polymorphic discriminator: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">type</code></p>
<details class="subtype-details">
<summary class="subtype-summary">
<span style="font-weight: 500;">AntigravityAgentConfig</span>
</summary>
<div class="subtype-content">
<p>Configuration for the Antigravity agent runtime.
Provides server-side control over the agent's execution environment

<details class="field-entry inline-details">
<summary class="signature">
<span class="expander-icon"></span>
<span class="field-name">safety_settings</span>
<span class="field-type">array (SafetySetting)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </summary>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Safety settings for the interaction.</p>
<section class="prototype" style="padding-left: 16px;">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<p style="display: none;">A safety setting that affects the safety-blocking behavior.

A SafetySetting consists of a
harm category and a
threshold for that
category.</p>
<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="fields_21" data-text="Fields" tabindex="-1">Fields</h4>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">method</span>
<span class="field-type">enum (string)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. The method for blocking content. If not specified, the default
behavior is to use the probability score.</p>
<p style="margin-top: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Possible
            values:</p>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">severity</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">The harm block method uses both probability and severity scores.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">probability</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">The harm block method uses the probability score.</p> </li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">threshold</span>
<span class="field-type">enum (string)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Required. The threshold for blocking content. If the harm probability
exceeds this threshold, the content will be blocked.</p>
<p style="margin-top: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Possible
            values:</p>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">block_low_and_above</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Block content with a low harm probability or higher.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">block_medium_and_above</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Block content with a medium harm probability or higher.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">block_only_high</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Block content with a high harm probability.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">block_none</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Do not block any content, regardless of its harm probability.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">off</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Turn off the safety filter entirely.</p> </li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<details class="field-entry inline-details">
<summary class="signature">
<span class="expander-icon"></span>
<span class="field-name">type</span>
<span class="field-type">HarmCategory</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </summary>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Required. The type of harm category to be blocked.</p>
<section class="prototype" style="padding-left: 16px;">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<p style="display: none;"></p>
<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="possible-values_11" data-text="Possible values" tabindex="-1">Possible values</h4>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">hate_speech</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Content that promotes violence or incites hatred against individuals or
groups based on certain attributes.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">dangerous_content</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Content that promotes, facilitates, or enables dangerous activities.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">harassment</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Abusive, threatening, or content intended to bully, torment, or ridicule.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">sexually_explicit</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Content that contains sexually explicit material.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">civic_integrity</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Deprecated: Election filter is not longer supported.
The harm category is civic integrity.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">image_hate</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Images that contain hate speech.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">image_dangerous_content</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Images that contain dangerous content.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">image_harassment</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Images that contain harassment.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">image_sexually_explicit</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Images that contain sexually explicit content.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">jailbreak</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Prompts designed to bypass safety filters.</p> </li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</details>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>

<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">status</span>
<span class="field-type">enum (string)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Required. Output only. The status of the interaction.</p>
<p style="margin-top: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Possible
            values:</p>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">in_progress</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">The interaction is in progress.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">requires_action</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">The interaction requires action/input from the user.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">completed</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">The interaction is completed.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">failed</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">The interaction failed.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">cancelled</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">The interaction was cancelled.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">incomplete</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">The interaction is completed, but contains incomplete results (e.g.
hitting max_tokens).</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">budget_exceeded</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">The interaction was halted because the token budget was exceeded.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">queued</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">The interaction is queued, waiting for processing.</p> </li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<h3 id="Resource:Tool" data-text="Tool" tabindex="-1">Tool</h3>
<section class="prototype">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<p>A tool that can be used by the model.</p>
<h3 id="possible-types_5" data-text="Possible Types" tabindex="-1">Possible Types</h3>
<details class="subtype-details">
<summary class="subtype-summary">
<span style="font-weight: 500;">CodeExecution</span>
</summary>
<div class="subtype-content">
<p>A tool that can be used by the model to execute code.</p>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">type</span>
<span class="field-type">object</span>
<span class="field-nessesity required"> (required)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>No description provided.</p>
<p>Always set to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"code_execution"</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</details>
<details class="subtype-details">
<summary class="subtype-summary">
<span style="font-weight: 500;">ComputerUse</span>
</summary>
<div class="subtype-content">
<p>A tool that can be used by the model to interact with the computer.</p>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">disabled_safety_policies</span>
<span class="field-type">array (enum (string))</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. Disabled safety policies for computer use.</p>
<p style="margin-top: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Possible
            values:</p>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">financial_transactions</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Safety policy for financial transactions.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">sensitive_data_modification</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Safety policy for sensitive data modification.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">communication_tool</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Safety policy for communication tools (e.g. Gmail, Chat, Meet).</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">account_creation</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Safety policy for account creation.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">data_modification</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Safety policy for data modification.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">user_consent_management</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Safety policy for user consent management.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">legal_terms_and_agreements</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Safety policy for legal terms and agreements.</p> </li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">enable_prompt_injection_detection</span>
<span class="field-type">boolean</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Whether enable the prompt injection detection check on computer-use
request.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">environment</span>
<span class="field-type">enum (string)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The environment being operated.</p>
<p style="margin-top: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Possible
            values:</p>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">browser</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Operates in a web browser.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">mobile</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Operates in a mobile environment.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">desktop</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Operates in a desktop environment.</p> </li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">excluded_predefined_functions</span>
<span class="field-type">array (string)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The list of predefined functions that are excluded from the model call.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">type</span>
<span class="field-type">object</span>
<span class="field-nessesity required"> (required)</span> </div>

<div itemscope="" itemtype="http://developers.google.com/ReferenceObject">
<h3 id="Resource:ResponseFormat" data-text="ResponseFormat" tabindex="-1">ResponseFormat</h3>
<section class="prototype">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<p></p>
<h3 id="possible-types_9" data-text="Possible Types" tabindex="-1">Possible Types</h3>
<details class="subtype-details">
<summary class="subtype-summary">
<span style="font-weight: 500;">AudioResponseFormat</span>
</summary>
<div class="subtype-content">
<p>Configuration for audio output format.</p>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">bit_rate</span>
<span class="field-type">integer</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Bit rate in bits per second (bps). Only applicable for compressed formats
(MP3, Opus).</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">delivery</span>
<span class="field-type">enum (string)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The delivery mode for the audio output.</p>
<p style="margin-top: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Possible
            values:</p>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">inline</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Audio data is returned inline in the response.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">uri</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Audio data is returned as a URI.</p> </li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">mime_type</span>
<span class="field-type">enum (string)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The MIME type of the audio output.</p>
<p style="margin-top: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Possible
            values:</p>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">audio/mp3</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">MP3 audio format.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">audio/ogg_opus</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">OGG Opus audio format.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">audio/l16</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Raw PCM (L16) audio format.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">audio/wav</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">WAV audio format.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">audio/alaw</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">A-law audio format.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">audio/mulaw</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Mu-law audio format.</p> </li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">sample_rate</span>
<span class="field-type">integer</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Sample rate in Hz.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">type</span>
<span class="field-type">object</span>
<span class="field-nessesity required"> (required)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>No description provided.</p>
<p>Always set to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"audio"</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</details>
<details class="subtype-details">

<span style="font-weight: 500;">ImageResponseFormat</span>
</summary>

<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>

<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">

<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">1:1</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">1:1 aspect ratio.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">2:3</code>

<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">3:2</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">3:2 aspect ratio.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">3:4</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">3:4 aspect ratio.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">4:3</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">4:3 aspect ratio.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">4:5</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">4:5 aspect ratio.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">5:4</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">5:4 aspect ratio.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">9:16</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">9:16 aspect ratio.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">16:9</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">16:9 aspect ratio.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">21:9</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">21:9 aspect ratio.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">1:8</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">1:8 aspect ratio.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">8:1</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">8:1 aspect ratio.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">1:4</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">1:4 aspect ratio.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">4:1</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">4:1 aspect ratio.</p> </li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">delivery</span>
<span class="field-type">enum (string)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The delivery mode for the image output.</p>
<p style="margin-top: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Possible
            values:</p>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">inline</code>

<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">uri</code>

</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">image_size</span>
<span class="field-type">enum (string)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The size of the image output.</p>
<p style="margin-top: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Possible
            values:</p>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">512</code>

<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">1K</code>

<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">2K</code>

<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">

<div itemscope="" itemtype="http://developers.google.com/ReferenceObject">
<h3 id="Resource:EnvironmentConfig" data-text="EnvironmentConfig" tabindex="-1">EnvironmentConfig</h3>
<section class="prototype">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<p>Configuration for a custom environment.</p>
<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="fields_93" data-text="Fields" tabindex="-1">Fields</h4>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">environment_id</span>
<span class="field-type">string</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. The environment ID for the interaction. If specified, the request will
update the existing environment instead of creating a new one.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">network</span>
<span class="field-type"><a href="#Resource:EnvironmentNetworkEgressAllowlist">EnvironmentNetworkEgressAllowlist</a> or enum (string)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Network configuration for the environment.</p>
<p style="margin-top: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Possible
            values:</p>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">disabled</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Turns all network off.</p> </li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<details class="field-entry inline-details">
<summary class="signature">
<span class="expander-icon"></span>
<span class="field-name">sources</span>
<span class="field-type">array (Source)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </summary>
<div class="field-description">
<p>No description provided.</p>
<section class="prototype" style="padding-left: 16px;">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<p style="display: none;">A source to be mounted into the environment.</p>
<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="fields_94" data-text="Fields" tabindex="-1">Fields</h4>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">content</span>
<span class="field-type">string</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The inline content if `type` is `INLINE`.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">encoding</span>
<span class="field-type">string</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional encoding for inline content (e.g. `base64`).</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">source</span>
<span class="field-type">string</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The source of the environment.
For Cloud Storage, this is the Cloud Storage path.
For GitHub, this is the GitHub path.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">target</span>
<span class="field-type">string</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Where the source should appear in the environment.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">type</span>
<span class="field-type">enum (string)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>No description provided.</p>
<p style="margin-top: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Possible
            values:</p>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">gcs</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">A Cloud Storage bucket.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">inline</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Inline content.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">repository</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">A generic repository. The protocol prefix in the source URL
identifies the provider (e.g., github://, gcs://).</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">skill_registry</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">A skill resource from the Skill Registry Service.
Skill: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/skills/{skill}
SkillRevision:
projects/{project}/locations/{location}/skills/{skill}/revisions/{revision}
Support mounting all skills under a project:
projects/{project}/locations/{location}/skills.</p> </li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</details>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">type</span>
<span class="field-type">object</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>No description provided.</p>
<p>Always set to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"remote"</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="second-column">
<div class="examples">

<div itemscope="" itemtype="http://developers.google.com/ReferenceObject">
<h3 id="Resource:EnvironmentNetworkEgressAllowlist" data-text="EnvironmentNetworkEgressAllowlist" tabindex="-1">EnvironmentNetworkEgressAllowlist</h3>
<section class="prototype">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<p>Outbound networking configuration for the sandbox. Accepts an object with an 'allowlist' array to restrict traffic, or the string 'disabled' to turn off all network access. Omit entirely to allow all outbound traffic with no header injection.</p>
<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="possible-types_13" data-text="Possible Types" tabindex="-1">Possible Types</h4>
<details class="subtype-details">
<summary class="subtype-summary">
<span style="font-weight: 500;">object</span>
</summary>
<div class="subtype-content">
<p>Outbound networking configuration for the sandbox. When specified, restricts which external domains the sandbox can reach. Omit entirely to allow all outbound traffic with no header injection.</p>
<details class="field-entry inline-details">
<summary class="signature">
<span class="expander-icon"></span>
<span class="field-name">allowlist</span>
<span class="field-type">array (AllowlistEntry)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </summary>
<div class="field-description">
<p>List of allowed outbound domains. Only requests to listed domains are permitted. Use [{'domain': '*'}] to allow all domains while still injecting headers on specific ones.</p>
<section class="prototype" style="padding-left: 16px;">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<p style="display: none;">A single domain allowlist rule with optional header injection.</p>
<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="fields_95" data-text="Fields" tabindex="-1">Fields</h4>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">domain</span>
<span class="field-type">string</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Domain to allow outbound requests to. Supports wildcards (e.g. '*.googleapis.com'). Use '*' to allow all domains.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">transform</span>
<span class="field-type">array (object) or object</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Headers to inject on all outbound requests matching this domain. Accepts a single dict or a list of dicts. The egress proxy injects these automatically.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</details>
</div>
</details>
<details class="subtype-details">
<summary class="subtype-summary">
<span style="font-weight: 500;">string</span>
</summary>
<div class="subtype-content">
<p>Turns all network off.</p>
</div>
</details>
<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="possible-values_44" data-text="Possible values" tabindex="-1">Possible values</h4>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">disabled</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Turns all network off.</p> </li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="second-column">
<div class="examples">
<h3 id="examples_7" data-text="Examples" tabindex="-1">Examples</h3>
<devsite-selector>
<section>
<h3 id="schema-example-EnvironmentNetworkEgressAllowlist-default" data-text="Example" tabindex="-1">Example</h3>
<div class="schema-example-content">
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" dir="ltr" translate="no" is-upgraded syntax="Bash"><span class="devsite-syntax-o">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"allowlist"</span>:<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">[</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"domain"</span>:<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"github.com"</span>,
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">      </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"transform"</span>:<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">[</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">          </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Authorization"</span>:<span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Bearer your-token"</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">        </span><span class="devsite-syntax-o">}</span>

<div class="field-description">

<section class="prototype" style="padding-left: 16px;">
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<p style="display: none;">The configuration for allowed tools.</p>
<h4 style="margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;" id="fields_97" data-text="Fields" tabindex="-1">Fields</h4>
<div class="field-entry">

<span class="field-type">enum (string)</span>
<span class="field-nessesity optional"> (optional)</span> </div>

<p style="margin-top: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; color: var(--devsite-text-secondary);">Possible
            values:</p>
<ul style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc;">

<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">auto</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Auto tool choice.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">any</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">Any tool choice.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">none</code>
<p style="margin-left: 16px; font-size: 13px;">No tool choice.</p> </li>
<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
<code style="font-size: 13px;" translate="no" dir="ltr">validated</code>

</ul>
</div>
</div>

<li style="margin-bottom: 4px;">
